notes.title: Let's meet at Tokyo Game Dungeon 9!
notes.content:
[p]We will be exhibiting our game, [b]METRO PENGUIN EUTOPIA[/b], at the indie game exhibition Tokyo Game Dungeon 9, which will be held tomorrow, August 3rd.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44666193/0cb9e61de31693c9390763ea1a8a4b19bb17caf1.png"][/img]The demo version is about 10-15 minutes long and mainly consists of battle scenes with mostly finalized specifications. There is almost no story, but you can get a taste of the battles with the killer penguins that are at the core of the game. Those who try the demo will receive a clear file. Please note that the number of files is limited.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44666193/8cecdc305d5d889b1be93b9ec75644f659e89d47.jpg"][/img][/p][p]↑We will be giving away clear files like this one. Different colors are also available. For more details about Tokyo Game Dungeon 9, please visit the official website. 
[/p][p][url="https://tokyogamedungeon.com/"]https://tokyogamedungeon.com/[/url]
[/p][p]The date of the next exhibition has not yet been decided. It will be about a year before the game is released, so if you would like to get a feel for the game, we would be delighted if you could visit the venue. Thank you very much. Wow![/p]
